ArtistData.name: Dhanda Nyoliwala
ArtistData.description: Dhanda Nyoliwala is a hip-hop artist known for his unique style, catchy tracks, and raw energy. His music blends Haryanvi culture with modern rap.

ArtistData.name: Backstage Siblings
ArtistData.description: Backstage Siblings is a devotional music collective known for transforming traditional bhajans into vibrant, high-energy live experiences. Blending soulful singing, live music and community participation, they create an atmosphere where audiences sing, dance and celebrate together.

ArtistData.name: Krishna Das
ArtistData.description: Krishna Das is a pioneering American vocalist known for bringing kirtan — a devotional chanting practice from India — to a global audience. Blending traditional Sanskrit mantras with Western musical influences like folk and rock, his soulful performances create a deep, meditative experience. Over decades, he has released numerous albums and toured worldwide, inspiring people across cultures through his spiritual music. Krishna Das is often credited with popularizing mantra chanting in the West and bridging East-West musical traditions.

ArtistData.name: Chaar Diwaari
ArtistData.description: Chaar Diwaari is the musical alias of Garv Taneja, a 20 year old music producer, singer/songwriter and a visual artist based in New Delhi, India. Diwaaari's primary focus is creating experimental Hindi music and pushing the boundaries of convention in art. Chaar Diwaari has seen a meteoric rise in just over a year of releases off the back of an intentional flippant forgoing of polish for low-budget rawness and the irreverent edge of modern-day internet humour – the defining quality of both his lyrics and music videos.

ArtistData.name: Niladri Kumaar
ArtistData.description:
Niladri Kumaar, one of India’s most celebrated contemporary classical artists. A sitar virtuoso and visionary composer, he is the creator of the Zitar, a groundbreaking fusion of sitar and guitar that has reimagined the possibilities of Indian classical music.

Trained in the rich legacy of Hindustani classical tradition, his artistry bridges heritage and innovation with effortless finesse. His work transcends genres, weaving together classical depth, global influences, and a distinctly modern sensibility, establishing him as a pioneering force shaping the future of Indian sound.

ArtistData.name: Abi Sampa
ArtistData.description: Abi Sampa is a multi-instrumentalist, Qawwal, and veena virtuoso whose jaw-dropping vocal prowess serves as the physical and emotional focal point of the ensemble. Born in Northwest London to Sri Lankan Tamil refugee parents, her identity was forged in a highly multicultural environment, allowing her to seamlessly absorb both Eastern and Western musical structures.

ArtistData.name: Arjun Vagale
ArtistData.description: Widely celebrated as the pioneer of techno in India, Arjun Vagale continues to steer the course of the country’s underground electronic movement. Known for his intense, driven and raw sound, Arjun is one of the most prolific artists to come out of Asia, and his cutting-edge productions have seen massive global reach. Receiving numerous awards and named one of “Asia’s finest underground music exports,” Arjun is an artist, DJ, producer, live act, label owner, radio show host, and all-round music entrepreneur.

ArtistData.name: Purbayan Chatterjee
ArtistData.description:
Purbayan Chatterjee is one of the most revered sitar maestros of the world, and belongs to the Senia Maihar Gharana founded by Baba Alauddin Khan. His gurus are his father Pt. Parthapratim Chatterjee, Ustad Ali Akbar Khan, and he’s undergone vocal training from Pt. Ajay Chakraborty and training in tabla from Pt. Arindo Chatterjee. 

Among the list of awards that he has received there is the Indian president awards, Aditya Vikram Birla award, Rotary international award, in addition to many other prestigious awards. 

Purbayan's music is inspired by the sound of Pt. Nikhil Banerjee. His music combines the tone and richness of the Nikhil Banerjee style and a contemporary touch of his own urbane sensitivity. He has conceptualised the ground-breaking project Shastriya Syndicate - the first Indian Classical Band - with a contemporary touch, which has
performed all over the world. Their album ‘Lehar’ released by Times Music in 2008
remained the best-seller for a year and a half.

Purbayan regularly collaborates with the likes of Shankar Mahadevan, Ustad Zakir
Hussain and the jazz legend Pat Metheny. He also has several international albums to his credit, apart from many classical albums on top record labels of the world. His albums ‘Leher’ and ‘Stringstruck’ have received several awards and have been celebrated worldwide. 

Today he is one of the most sought-after musicians in the country and a global
ambassador for Indian classical music.

ArtistData.name: Kabul Bukhari
ArtistData.description: Kabul Bukhari is a powerhouse performer, a vocal force, and a true revivalist of contemporary Qawwali. With a voice that commands attention and stirs emotion, he brings a fresh, electrifying energy to the stage by blending the raw passion of traditional Sufi music with a modern, high-octane performance style. From soulful melodies to foot-stomping rhythms, his music transcends language and generations, turning every performance into a celebration of sound, movement, and culture. His ability to ignite audiences—whether in intimate settings or stadium arenas—has earned him a rapidly growing fan base and sold-out shows across the country.

ArtistData.name: Neelesh Misra
ArtistData.description: Neelesh Misra is an Indian singer-songwriter, lyricist, storyteller, author, filmmaker, and journalist whose work bridges music, literature, and cinema. Known for his evocative lyrics in acclaimed Bollywood films including Barfi!, Ek Tha Tiger, Dil Toh Baccha Hai Ji, and Jism, he has also captivated millions through his storytelling projects such as Yaadon Ka Idiot Box and The Slow Interviews. As an independent artist, Neelesh creates deeply personal music that blends poetic lyricism with intimate storytelling, celebrating nostalgia, human connection, and the quiet beauty of everyday life.

ArtistData.name: Nandy Sisters
ArtistData.description: Nandy Sisters is a powerhouse Indian musical duo comprising sisters Antara and Ankita Nandy. Celebrated for spark-igniting a digital revolution with their viral "Balcony Concert" series, they have seamlessly transitioned from internet sensations to highly respected mainstream artists. Antara, classically trained under Ustad Rashid Khan and a notable finalist on Sa Re Ga Ma Pa L'il Champs, alongside Ankita, a prolific playback voice for prominent television serials, blend traditional Indian music with a fresh, global acoustic appeal.

ArtistData.name: Harshit Mahawar
ArtistData.description: Harshit is the master of witty and sharp humor, turning everyday chaos into laugh-out-loud moments. In 2024, he took the ultimate risk—quitting his job without telling his parents—to chase his dream of stand-up comedy full-time.

ArtistData.name: Tapan Raj
ArtistData.description: Tapan Raj is one half of the internationally acclaimed electronic music duo Midival Punditz. A Delhi-based producer with a three-decade-long career, he has toured the world with the Punditz, launched technology products globally, and played an instrumental role in shaping Delhi’s underground electronic music scene since its early days in 1997. His eclectic DJ sets weave together World, Hip Hop, House, Breakbeats, Ghazal, Qawwali, Sufi, Garage, DnB and Techno, while his continued collaborations with like-minded artists from across the globe keep pushing the boundaries of underground music.

ArtistData.name: Shashi Dhiman
ArtistData.description:
"Shashi Dhiman is an Indian stand-up comedian, YouTuber, and former pharma scientist from Chandigarh. Born 18 February 1995 in Chandigarh (Punjab/Haryana), she grew up in the city, pursued a pharma-related degree, and worked as a pharma scientist by day while doing comedy by night.

Friends encouraged her after they laughed at her stories, so she began performing at the few open mics available in Chandigarh. To find a real scene, she moved to Mumbai in 2020, hitting up to four open mics a day, writing, testing material, and settling into a 9-to-7 day job alongside gigs.

Her breakthrough came online—her YouTube channel (started Jan 2019) now has 500K–650K+ subscribers and 130M–250M+ views, with viral crowd-work bits like “Ex by Chance,” “Siblings,” and “choti bacchi ho kya.” She also has 340K–460K Instagram followers (@sassygirlofficial). She’s noted for a distinct Punjabi accent, refreshing delivery, and balancing humor with empathy while tackling real-life experiences, stereotypes, and womanhood.

Dhiman finished as runner-up on Amazon Prime’s _Comicstaan_ Season 3 (2022) and has performed across India—Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Lucknow, etc.—with her solo show _Pannu Yaar_ and later shows drawing from marriage, love, and societal expectations. She anchored and created fun content for Punjab Kings’ social handles during IPL 2023, going viral as the team’s “mystery girl” and interviewing players.

She’s appeared at Foxtale’s No Fox Given (2025) alongside Swati Sachdeva, performed at college fests (Chitkara University), and is described as unapologetic yet respectful—standing by her truth while keeping jokes relatable rather than judgmental. Now based in Mumbai, she continues to tour, post clips, and be one of the prominent young female voices in Indian stand-up."

ArtistData.name: Jay Drive
ArtistData.description: Jay Drive is the alter ego of Jaidev Kaushik, a DJ and programmer for Auro and Summerhouse with over a decade of experience behind the decks. His journey has been built from the ground up, shaped by years working as a stage manager at Magnetic Fields, a project manager at Konnekt, and previously as a resident DJ at Auro and Summerhouse. Drawing inspiration from artists such as DVS1, Raresh, Ricardo Villalobos, Cap and Freddy K, Jay Drive’s sets traverse Electronica, Minimal, House, Trance, and Techno, delivering immersive and dynamic musical journeys. Guided by deep curiosity and relentless passion, his craft continues to evolve with every performance.

ArtistData.name: Jeeveshu Ahluwalia
ArtistData.description: With a grandeur that resembles Salman Khan and a mother wishing for her son to get married (also like Sallu bhai), Jeeveshu Ahluwalia’s comedy brings out the fat Punjabi guy’s perspective on everything that surrounds him. Jeeveshu’s quick wit and knock out punchlines have saved him from many disasters, apart from making sellout venues laugh till their faces hurt. Think his face looks familiar? The comedian made his Bollywood debut with the Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone-starrer Tamasha, and has appeared in TV commercials for Comedy Central India, Phillips, Apollo Hospitals, ICICI Prudential and Grofers. Winner of Radio Mirchi's Comedy Ka King 2014, the comedian has done over 1500 shows, and has performed in countries like Singapore, Dubai, Doha, Thailand, Philippines and Malaysia.

ArtistData.name: Abijit Ganguly
ArtistData.description: A Bengali living in Delhi, Abijit Ganguly's humor tackles the most mundane Indian problems like parents, pressure of getting married and buying condoms in the most unapologetic way. The bi-lingual comedian performs in both Hindi and English, is over 2000 shows old and NDTV has repeatedly named him as one of the Rising Stars of Comedy in India. When he is not packing venues on comedy nights or doing corporate shows, the Delhi School of Economics graduate poses as a brand consultant to major multi-corporations like Woo, Sprite, Culture Machine and OYO Rooms, and also as a freelance writer. The comedian has appeared on various TedX Talks, dishing gyan about being on stage, following dreams, and earning your bread in the process.

ArtistData.name: Chirag Panjwani
ArtistData.description:
Chirag Panjwani is an Indian stand-up comedian known for his relatable, anecdotal, and observational humor. He has a background in engineering and holds an MBA, but he transitioned to a full-time career in comedy.
Originally from Agra, Panjwani has performed extensively across India's comedy circuit, including in cities like Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, building his career since 2012.
